Standing out isn’t about gimmicks. It’s about making your best work impossible to miss in a 15-second skim.

undefined

This guide is for career switchers and mid-journey professionals who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

undefined

Do this next

  1. Lead with transferable outcomes
  2. Group projects by theme, not by year alone
  3. State the role you’re aiming for in one sentence

Make uniqueness visible

Your uniqueness is already in your projects and judgment. The website’s job is to frame that judgment so a stranger trusts it quickly.

How a website helps you stand out

A portfolio lets you reframe your past as evidence for the future role — not as a chronological apology.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Lead with transferable outcomes
  • Group projects by theme, not by year alone
  • State the role you’re aiming for in one sentence

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
